decisions.reason: After two years the firm has had time to absorb market feedback on this closely related carpet and can more likely refine its materials, positioning and use in interior projects than withdraw it.

This hand-knotted wool silk carpet remains strongly aligned with the firm's craftsmanship and premium-material knowledge, so accumulated learning supports continued retention with only limited withdrawal risk.

The corner bench sits squarely within the firm's core furniture and project capabilities, making it highly improvable through existing design, customization and contract-market knowledge rather than a candidate for exit.

Although the firm can support this low-pile carpet with established know-how, the earlier removal of a similar carpet line means assortment rationalisation still creates a meaningful but not dominant risk of withdrawal.

The swivel shell chair line is deeply connected to the firm's residential, workplace and public-interior expertise, and its model variety gives strong scope to learn, adapt and keep the range in the market.
